summary: Stantec filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 results. Net revenue rose 9.1% to $1.7 billion, adjusted EPS grew 14.7% to $1.33, and contract backlog reached a record $9.0 billion. The filing reaffirms mid-to-high single-digit organic growth guidance for 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
